response.sql: WITH race_totals AS (SELECT r.name AS race_name, SUM(res.points) AS total_points FROM results res JOIN races r ON r.raceId = res.raceId GROUP BY r.name), avg_total AS (SELECT AVG(total_points) AS avg_points FROM race_totals), above_avg AS (SELECT rt.race_name, rt.total_points, a.avg_points FROM race_totals rt CROSS JOIN avg_total a WHERE rt.total_points > a.avg_points) SELECT SUM(ab.total_points) AS combined_total_points, (SELECT AVG(CAST(res.laps AS REAL)) FROM results res JOIN races r ON r.raceId = res.raceId WHERE r.name IN (SELECT race_name FROM above_avg)) AS avg_laps, AVG(ab.total_points - ab.avg_points) AS avg_excess_over_average FROM above_avg ab;
